dedupe_keys.name: operational inputs for pcr globwb2 data derived reservoir operations

description: Jennie Steyaert and colleagues publish input maps for data-derived reservoir operations in PCR-GLOBWB2. Zenodo serves a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The author description lists reservoir identifier maps for 250 km, 650 km and 1,100 km downstream command areas, a reservoir-use map, yearly reservoir maps and weekly NetCDF files holding random-forest-derived storage bounds. These inputs can support global reservoir-release and downstream-water-availability simulations under alternative command-area assumptions. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this operations-input bundle; the authors cite a separate static DOI for the PCR-GLOBWB2 model implementation. A limitation is that the page does not define all map fields or the years included, and storage bounds derived from a fitted model are not observed operating rules. The ZIP was not downloaded, so file inventory, weekly time coverage and simulation outcomes were not independently checked.
